items.label: Existing-boss phase / mobility / Brutal quality passes
items.status: Constable, Warden and Courier phase/mobility/advanced-form implementation passes complete; human acceptance remains open. Other 57 original-roster encounters await assessment/redesign.

items.label: Ability-changing class-upgrade revamps
items.status: Three actual ability transformations per class (21 total) implemented at existing utility-path depth three, with shared authority, cues and fifteen-locale help. Rendered/human balance/device/native-language acceptance remains open.

items.label: Optional large branching skill-tree view
items.status: Optional all-54-skill map implemented for all seven classes with settings toggle, bounded zoom, scrolling and keyboard navigation. Classic remains the default; rendered/human/device/native-language review remains open.

items.label: Secondary-map topology revamps
items.status: Five distinct secondary layouts installed. Four spacious maps now have compact real geometry; Ossuary/Crown routes retain their size. Difficulty cover/lava, movement and prediction remain shared. Human 5185 feedback motivated the compact pass; its rendered/human/device comparison remains open.

items.label: Map ground-art deliveries
items.status: Six ground deliveries installed. Limited Normal/Constable readability feedback is positive.

items.label: Early Watch motion and encounter integration
items.status: Three encounters, 36 selected poses, individual themes and fifteen-locale help implemented. Limited 5179 phase/pacing feedback informed the new two-phase/difficulty pass; its human comparison, rendered and listening review remain open.

items.label: Small Wakes motion and encounter integration
items.status: Three original two-phase encounters, 36 selected poses, individual scores and fifteen-locale help implemented. Rendered/human balance/device/native-language/listening acceptance remains open. Limited 5185 human comparison confirms clearer phases and harder Brutal, with arena retreat feedback still requiring review.

items.label: Crazed form integration
items.status: All 66 identities inherit their full Brutal signatures plus purple C treatment, 7.5x projectile budgets, warned pursuit/crosscut/weave pressure, forced Hellish and persisted Endless progression. This common variant pass adds no roster or original-quality credit; human balance/rendered/device acceptance remains open.

latestHumanFeedback: Human comparison on frozen 5185: phase differences and Standard/Brutal difficulty are clearer, though these entry bosses remain easy. Large retreat corners let players disengage and reduce dash value. Requested smaller maps, a more atmospheric boss header, forced Insane Brutal, forced Hellish Crazed with purple/C treatment, higher projectile budgets and Standard-to-Brutal-to-Crazed Endless progression; phase sound and later bespoke animation were also requested.

Latest requested refinement: Normal combat revival is now 25%; Baby/Easy shield events have six/three circles and two/three-second channels; Baby gains two additional cover props per map. Shared authority/prediction/UI and software checks implement the request; human comparison remains open.

Manual feedback on frozen 5179: Early Watch bosses defeated quickly; phase changes were only partly visible. Two longer entry phases, health-bar dividers and a separate transition banner are now implemented and await human comparison.

Requested phase shield-break only on Baby/Easy Standard, no shield event in Brutal, full-health Baby revival, half-health Easy and quarter-health Normal revival, and no combat revives at Hard or above. One authority policy and fifteen-locale difficulty cards now implement these rules.

Requested stronger Brutal projectile sequences and harder arena rules: warned repeat volleys, half cover on Hard, no interior cover on Insane/Hellish, Hellish lava and all Insane bosses Brutal and all Hellish bosses Crazed are implemented. Rendered/human balance acceptance remains open.
Constable became slightly harder; being one of the easiest bosses is appropriate. Do not turn its Normal form into a high-threat encounter.
Phase transitions still felt subtle, and Brutal looked and played too similarly. The latest phase-cue, red treatment and extra-sequence implementation awaits another human check.
Music was acceptable but could be a little more intense. A quiet tempo-aligned percussion layer now responds to phase and Brutal; human listening review remains open.
Earlier map bullets and warnings were readable on Normal with Hollow Constable. This is limited evidence, not full map/device acceptance.
